title: Profiles
description: Named environments — capture your setup and switch between them

empty.title: No profiles yet
empty.desc: Capture your current agent config as a named environment, then apply it any time (e.g. on another machine or to switch setups).

confirmApply.title: Apply “{{name}}”?
confirmApply.desc: This overwrites your current agent config with the profile's. A snapshot of each file is taken first (see History), so it can be undone.

confirmDelete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
confirmDelete.desc: This removes the saved profile. Your live config is untouched.

templates.heading: Environment templates
templates.desc: Templates capture your current config under a named environment.
